info.title: Sterling Commerce Solutions Agent Search API
info.description: Read-only service discovery API for AI assistants and agentic search clients. Returns public service information only; it does not submit forms, access customer records, or make purchases.

get.summary: Search public Sterling Commerce Solutions services
get.description: Find relevant public service offerings using a natural-language query. Omit q to list all services. Supply slug to retrieve a specific service.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Plain-language search query, for example Google Merchant Center misrepresentation or Shopify store design.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Exact service slug returned by a previous search.
